## Summary
- Prompt reviewer lanes to inspect existing inline review comments and emit optional structured suggestions without mutating GitHub.
- Allow review synthesis to reply to existing inline comments or mark older same-agent inline comments as outdated, with guardrails against deleting comments, resolving threads, or touching human/other-bot comments.
- Add prompt-contract assertions covering the new inline comment suggestion and mutation rules.

## Verification
- `npm run build`
- `node --test dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #168

## Notes

- The strongest rubric fit is surgical/simple implementation: the PR directly implements the scoped prototype from issue #168 and the linked PR #163 discussion.
- The main rubric gap is documentation. Since review synthesis can now reply to inline comments and minimize old same-agent inline comments, the behavior should be reflected in the relevant `.agent/docs` review/workflow documentation.
- No rubric-specific follow-up is needed for route authorization, merge strategy, preview contracts, or compact status comments; those selected rubrics do not materially apply to this prompt-only PR.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** `keep-docs-in-sync` is only partially satisfied. The PR changes review automation behavior that users may observe on PRs, but it updates only prompts/tests. Add a concise note to the review workflow docs explaining that synthesis may post new inline comments, reply to existing inline comments, and mark older same-agent inline comments as outdated under the stated guardrails.

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #169 implements the prompt-managed inline review comment prototype requested by issue #168 and the linked PR #163 discussion.
- Reviewer lanes now inspect existing inline review comments and can emit structured `Inline Comment Suggestions` without mutating GitHub.
- Review synthesis can use those suggestions to post inline comments, reply to inline comments, or mark older same-agent inline comments as outdated.
- The change is intentionally prompt-focused, with prompt-contract assertions added in `envelope.test.ts`.

## Review
- The PR is directionally sound and keeps the implementation small, but several guardrails need tightening before this should merge. There are no BLOCKING issues, but the remaining WARNING items are concrete and safe for a fix-pr pass.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Reply actions lack a same-agent guard | WARNING | `reply_existing` is allowed “when useful” without the same authorship/uncertainty guard used for minimization, even though the linked design constrained inline mutations to same-agent comments. |
| Prompt-contract tests miss mutation preconditions | WARNING | The test pins mutation shapes and minimization authorship, but not the re-fetch/PR-ownership precondition or a reply authorship guard. |
| Inline suggestion fields need clearer roles | WARNING | `finding` and `suggested_body` are listed together without defining which is issue context and which is the exact postable comment text. |
| Docs missing for prompt-managed inline behavior | WARNING | The PR changes user-visible review synthesis behavior, but docs still only describe generated-comment cleanup and `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS`. |

## Progress
- Inline comments were posted for the reply guard, test coverage gap, and suggestion-field ambiguity.
- The existing rubrics review already clearly flagged the docs-sync gap, so no duplicate inline docs comment was posted.
- Reviewers agreed the prompt-only prototype is appropriately scoped.
- Reviewers differed on `review-synthesize-finalize.md`: one flagged the registered-but-unused prompt as a future guardrail risk, while the linked discussion explicitly left it out because the current workflow does not call it. This synthesis treats that as out of scope for the current fix.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Reply actions lack a same-agent guard</summary>

**Cause:** `review-synthesize.md` allows synthesis to reply to an existing inline review comment “when useful,” but the same-agent and human/other-bot restrictions are only stated for minimization.

**Candidate solutions:** Add an explicit rule that `reply_existing` may only target comments from the same authenticated agent account when authorship and PR ownership are certain, or document a narrower intentional exception for replies.

**Comments:** Inline feedback was posted on `.github/prompts/review-synthesize.md:28`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Prompt-contract tests miss mutation preconditions</summary>

**Cause:** The test asserts `in_reply_to`, `minimizeComment`, same-agent minimization, no delete/resolve, and Progress reporting, but it does not assert the re-fetch/PR-ownership guard or the reply-authorship guard.

**Candidate solutions:** Add regex assertions for re-fetching existing inline comments, verifying the target still belongs to the PR, and the reply same-agent rule once added.

**Comments:** Inline feedback was posted on `.agent/src/__tests__/envelope.test.ts:377`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Inline suggestion fields need clearer roles</summary>

**Cause:** The reviewer prompt lists `finding` and `suggested_body` on the same schema line without explaining how synthesis should use each one.

**Candidate solutions:** Split them into separate bullets with parenthetical roles, or remove one field if `rationale` plus `suggested_body` is enough.

**Comments:** Inline feedback was posted on `.github/prompts/review.md:30`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Docs missing for prompt-managed inline behavior</summary>

**Cause:** `.agent/docs` describes generated review-comment cleanup and `AGENT_COLLAPSE_OLD_REVIEWS`, but not the new prompt-managed inline reply/minimization behavior.

**Candidate solutions:** Add a concise note to the relevant review workflow docs explaining when synthesis may post, reply, or minimize inline comments and that this behavior is separate from deterministic generated-comment cleanup.

**Comments:** This was already covered by the posted rubrics review, so it was not duplicated inline.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The remaining issues are concrete prompt, test, and docs edits that are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Add a same-agent/authorship uncertainty guard for `reply_existing` in `review-synthesize.md`.
- [ ] Extend the prompt-contract test to assert re-fetch/PR-ownership checks and the reply guard.
- [ ] Clarify the distinct roles of `finding` and `suggested_body` in `review.md`.
- [ ] Update `.agent/docs` to describe the new prompt-managed inline comment behavior.
